svg.title: The leaves: when to cast
svg.text: L1 of Sunny → No horse (14% of plays). Each leaf is a cast frame that lands the Power Nut.
Cast 0.72 s after READY, let go at bite 1: the Nut.
One game frame earlier or later: no Nut on bite 1.
Casting changes the sunlight: the line in the water draws
numbers of its own. You cast to intercept a leaf.
Lab: every cast frame from READY on this line (1,197 casts), each fished to every bite; leaf colours as in the app.
